title: NeoOrigins Condition
description: A condition (predicate) used in power fields like `condition` and `entity_action.condition`. The `type` field discriminates.

type.description: Condition verb. The namespace is optional and any namespace is accepted (`origins:`, `apoli:`, `apugli:`, `apace:`, a bare leaf, or an addon prefix): the parser canonicalises the prefix away and dispatches on the leaf, so it is the leaf that must be a known verb.

condition.description: Inner condition evaluated on the actor (the player).

advancement.description: Advancement id the player must have completed.

conditions.description: List of sub-conditions; all must pass (absent/empty → true).

biome.description: Exact biome id at the player's position (shape 1; highest precedence).

tag.description: Biome tag the player's biome must be in (shape 2).

biome_tag.description: Synonym for `tag` used by several built-in JSONs (shape 2).

condition.description: Nested biome sub-condition (shape 3). Its own small grammar, separate from the entity conditions: `in_tag` (biome tag), `temperature` (comparison/compare_to on base temperature), `precipitation` (none/rain/snow at the player's block), `high_humidity` (downfall above 0.85), `biome` (nested exact-id or tag form), `constant`, and the `and`/`all_of`, `or`/`any_of`, `not` combinators. Each honours `inverted`. Anything else fails closed. Absent all of biome/tag/biome_tag/condition → always true.

block_condition.description: Optional nested block condition wrapper; otherwise the fields are read off the root.

block.description: Block id the block at the player's position must match (also accepts `id`).

tag.description: Block tag the block at the player's position must be in (absent block+tag → always true).

offset_x.description: Bounding-box X shift as a multiple of the entity's width (default 0).

offset_y.description: Bounding-box Y shift as a multiple of the entity's height (default 0).

offset_z.description: Bounding-box Z shift as a multiple of the entity's width (default 0).

block_condition.description: Optional block filter; when present, at least one intersected block must match.

trait.description: Which Cold Sweat temperature trait to read (default `core`). `core` is the player's body temp on a roughly -100 (freezing death) … +100 (burning death) scale, 0 = neutral. `base`/`world` use the ambient scale. `heat_resistance`/`cold_resistance`/`heat_dampening`/`cold_dampening` are 0..1-ish resistances. `freezing_point`/`burning_point` are the body-temp thresholds; `rate` is the change-rate multiplier.

compare_to.description: The threshold the reading is compared against. For `core`, e.g. `compare_to: 50, comparison: ">="` is true once the player is getting dangerously hot; `compare_to: -50, comparison: "<="` catches dangerous cold.

light_type.description: Which light layer to sample (default any/max local brightness).

condition.description: Entity condition that activates climbing; absent → always active.

hold_condition.description: Entity condition that keeps an active climb going after `condition` stops (evaluated while airborne); absent → hold until touchdown.

allow_holding.description: Whether an active climb may persist after `condition` stops (default true).

command.description: Command to run; compared against its return value (blank → false).

compare_to.description: Threshold for the command's return value (default 1).

key.description: Config-flag key whose live boolean to return (unknown key → true, with a warning).

value.description: Constant result this condition always returns (default false).

power.description: Power id whose cooldown to test (absent → always true).

distance.description: How many blocks above the player to scan for a non-air block (default 8, min 1).

name.description: Damage-source message id to match, case-insensitive (absent → false).

tag.description: Damage-type tag the incoming damage must be in (absent → false).

damage_type.description: Damage-type id the incoming damage must match (absent → false).

dimension.description: Dimension id the player must be in (absent → always true).

reference.description: Reference point: world_origin (0,0,0) or world_spawn (default world_origin).

offset.description: Per-axis {x,y,z} offset added to the reference point.

shape.description: Distance metric: cube (Chebyshev), star (Manhattan), sphere (Euclidean). Default cube.

ignore_x.description: Exclude the X axis from the distance (default false).

ignore_y.description: Exclude the Y axis from the distance (default false).

ignore_z.description: Exclude the Z axis from the distance (default false).

result_on_the_wrong_dimension.description: Distance value substituted when off the reference's dimension (absent → use real distance).

enchantment.description: Enchantment id to look for across equipped items (absent → always true).

entity_type.description: Entity-type id to match (player is always minecraft:player; absent → always true).

equipment_slot.description: Equipment slot to inspect (default mainhand). `accessory` inspects equipped Curios/Accessories slots (soft-dep, 1.21.1 only).

slot_type.description: Only used when equipment_slot is `accessory`: narrows to a named accessory/curio slot type (e.g. ring, belt, hands); absent → any accessory slot.

item_condition.description: Nested item condition; absent → slot-presence check (any item present).

id.description: Item id the eaten stack must match exactly (absent → false).

key.description: Config list key whose id/#tag entries the eaten stack must match (e.g. ocean_origins.extra_fish_foods); unknown key → false.

tag.description: Item tag (#-prefixed) the eaten stack must be in, or a bare item id to match exactly (absent → false).

effect.description: Mob-effect id the player must currently have (absent → false).

block_condition.description: Nested block condition with `block`/`id`; absent → always true.
Nested block condition tested against every block the player's hitbox overlaps; absent → always true.

comparison.description: Comparison operator against the overlap count (default >=).

set.description: Entity-set key on the actor; true iff the target's UUID is in it.

tag.description: Biome tag the player's biome must be in (absent → always true).

inventory_types.description: Inventories to scan: `inventory` (main inventory incl. hotbar, armor, offhand) and/or `ender_chest`. Default: inventory only.

process_mode.description: `stacks` counts matching stacks; `items` sums their stack counts.

item_condition.description: Per-stack predicate; absent → any non-empty stack counts.

compare_to.description: Count threshold (default 0 — i.e. "has at least one match").

light_type.description: Which light layer to sample (default any/max local brightness).

compare_to.description: Moon phase 0..7 (0 = full moon, 4 = new moon; default 0).

nbt.description: Key the player's persistent data must contain (absent → always true).

blocks.description: List of block ids to match (any → counts).

tag.description: Single block tag to match (#-prefix optional).

tags.description: List of block tags to match (any → counts).

block_condition.description: Origins block_in_radius shape: nested block condition (block/in_tag/combinators/inverted). Requires at least one of block/blocks/tag/tags/block_condition.

comparison.description: Comparison operator against the matching-block count (default >=).

compare_to.description: Count threshold (default 1 — i.e. "any matching block nearby").

entity_type.description: Entity-type id, or #tag, to look for nearby.

comparison.description: Comparison operator against the villager count (default >=).

entity_types.description: List of entity-type ids or #tags to count (any → counts).

bientity_condition.description: Condition evaluated as (player, nearby entity); only matching entities count. A verb that cannot apply to a non-player entity fails the condition closed.

radius.description: Apoli spelling of distance; takes precedence when both are present.

comparison.description: Comparison operator against the matching-entity count (default >=).

compare_to.description: Count threshold (default 1 — i.e. "any matching entity nearby").

condition.description: Nested condition whose result is negated.

block_condition.description: Nested block condition (block id / in_tag / and / or) tested against the block below; absent → on any ground.

conditions.description: List of sub-conditions; at least one must pass (absent/empty → false).

origin.description: Origin id the player must currently have.

layer.description: Restrict the match to a single origin layer (absent → any layer).

ticks.description: Ticks since last damage required (default 100 = 5 s).

power.description: Power id the player must have been granted.
Toggle power id to test; `*` wildcard suffix-matches toggle keys.

power_type.description: Power-type id to match across granted powers (also accepts `id`; bare → origins: prefixed).

predicate_type.description: Which vanilla predicate to compile (damage fails closed; needs hit-context).

predicate.description: The predicate JSON, parsed against the matching vanilla codec.

resource.description: Resource power id whose stored value to read.

objective.description: Scoreboard objective to read the player's score from (absent → false).

statistic.description: Stat to read. Either a plain id — `minecraft:time_since_rest`, which implies the `minecraft:custom` category — or an object `{ "type": "minecraft:killed", "stat": "minecraft:zombie" }`. Categories: custom, mined, crafted, used, broken, picked_up, dropped, killed, killed_by. Absent or unresolvable → false.

stat.description: Alias for statistic (the Apoli field name); same plain-id or object shape.

effect.description: Mob-effect id the player must have (absent → false).

amplifier.description: Exact amplifier to require (sets both min and max).

fluid.description: Fluid id whose submersion to test (minecraft:water / minecraft:lava).

group.description: Vanilla mob category/group the target must be in (absent → false).

state.description: Weather state to match — rain/raining and thunder/thundering are synonyms (also accepts the `value` field; default clear).

oneOf.$comment: Fallback branch — any registered type not exhaustively schema'd yet. Allows extra fields permissively.
